### Desecrating the Sanctuary
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/desecrating-sanctuary
Passage: Matthew 24:23-28
Points:
- Comparing parallel gospel accounts like Luke 21:20 clarifies that Jesus was foretelling Jerusalem's siege and destruction in AD 70.
- The extreme suffering and loss of life during Rome's assault explain Jesus’ urgent warning to flee Judea immediately.
- The abomination of desolation occurred when Titus placed Roman eagle standards at the temple gate and offered pagan sacrifices.
- Jerusalem's fall demonstrates the severe judgment that follows when a nation refuses to submit to Christ.
- Believers must take their walk with the Lord seriously and remain faithful, obedient servants.
